rules.statement: The Chief of Staff role does not independently diagnose, prescribe, determine treatment, or replace licensed clinical judgment.
Patient-facing actions and communications require appropriate human authorization and workflow controls.
Modification of clinical or patient records must use authorized systems, identity controls, and role-based permissions.
Potential patient-safety signals receive enhanced human oversight and must not be suppressed by productivity objectives.
Minimize exposure of sensitive personal and health data to the minimum required for the task.
